summary: Excellent TypeScript practices: explicit types, pure functions, meaningful error handling. Workflow well-structured (minimal permissions, sensible triggers, proper shell setup). Minor issues: workflow assumes package.json with test:unit script (lines 33–34) not shown in deliverable; output mechanism works (TS writes $GITHUB_OUTPUT, workflow reads via steps context) but indirect—step doesn't explicitly echo outputs. No dead code or duplication. Would be higher but for implicit dependencies and less-obvious output plumbing.
